text:
Hello, just to share our experienced in the branch. MH Hadera doesn’t usually reply to emails. It’s better to go there in person and fill out an appointment request form, then wait for their response.
In our case, we sent many emails and never got a reply. My visa expired on February 11, and we had a March 8 appointment, but it was canceled because the war broke out. My visa wasn’t included in the automatic digital extension, so I was without a valid visa for almost 4 months.
When we finally got our appointment, the clerk said the documents I had submitted online were already outdated. She asked me to bring updated utility bills, photos, and chat records from January to June, and said she would issue my visa on the spot. I went back alone with the updated documents and received my visa on June 11. Also, give your wife’s Teudat Zehut to the security guard so they can check if you already have an appointment. Their system seems a bit mixed up. That’s actually how we found out about ours—we never received an SMS notification, and the guard checked it on their computer.
